However, thanks to Gustave Eiffel's forward-thinking design, it not only survived but thrived, becoming a crucial site for communication and scientific endeavors. They listed the estate for $39.5 million in August 2019 before reducing the asking price to $33.9 million. However, the property failed to sell and was withdrawn in May 2020 amid the coronavirus pandemic and its impact on luxury real estate.

title: Eva Longoria on $50m gift from Bezos and Sanchez: 'You needn't be a billionaire'
description: In 2024, Eva Longoria received $50 million from Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sánchez through the Bezos Courage and Civility Award. Two years later, the actor and philanthropist is highlighting how making a difference does not require immense wealth. She says mentoring, supporting small businesses and sharing knowledge can also create meaningful change in communities.

title: Chennai teen writes 160 nature poems and publishes two books before 15
description: K. B. Kiruthikarani, a talented teen from Chennai, has captivated readers with her two poetry collections that explore the beauty of nature. Her first book, 'Dewdrops: A Gallery of Nature Poetry', debuted in 2023, followed by 'Earthen Writes: The Diary of an Earthling' in 2024. At just 15, she was honored by the India Book of Records, showcasing her profound love for the natural world through her verse.

title: Pennsylvania family builds 70-foot pirate ship for Halloween
description: Chris Clark built a large pirate ship named 'Miss Fortune' as a Halloween attraction at his sister's home. The project, which started in spring, involved months of planning and construction with community support. Previous themes included a circus and a Western town, showcasing Clark's creative ideas. Visitors are welcomed by costumed characters who enhance the interactive experience during Halloween festivities.

title: Juwan Howard sells Coral Gables mansion for $25 million
description: Former NBA star and two-time champion Juwan Howard has sold his newly built Coral Gables mansion for $25 million, below its $28.9 million asking price. Located in the exclusive Journey’s End community, the seven-bedroom estate features a private marina access, resort-style pool and luxury amenities. Howard bought the 1.73-acre property for $3.4 million in 2013.

title: Wyoming landowner wins road access to 640 acres, must pay $61,200
description: After facing challenges in accessing its secluded property in Wyoming, Wagonhound Land & Livestock Company turned to the courts for a solution. Following failed negotiations for access, they sought legal permission for a private road. The Wyoming Supreme Court ruled in favor of the company, confirming the road’s necessity and awarding compensation to the neighboring ranch, while also lifting two restrictions on road standards.

title: US sanctions Indian couple, 9 firms over alleged Iran oil trade fraud
Australian mining heiress pledges $120 million to 10 environmental groups
description: In a groundbreaking move, an Australian mining heiress and her spouse have gifted A$120 million to ten environmental organizations nationwide, marking one of the most significant private donations for conservation in Australian history. Among the beneficiaries, Greenpeace Australia Pacific will receive A$25 million, enabling it to enhance campaigns and engage in lengthy legal battles. This funding represents a transformative approach to how mining revenue supports environmental efforts.

title: Utah girl missing for 17 months rescued from Oregon home; man charged
description: A 17-year-old girl missing from Utah was located in Oregon after investigators received a tip about her. The girl had communicated with another minor online, revealing she was being held against her will. The FBI monitored a video call during which she identified the man who had picked her up. Adam Hunter Harmel, 39, was arrested and charged with transporting a minor for illegal sexual activities.

title: New Jersey woman wins $173,000 after warned-about oak tree hits home
description: In a remarkable case in New Jersey, a homeowner secured $173,000 in damages after an oak tree, reported multiple times as hazardous, fell and damaged her property. The nearby utility company was found negligent in maintaining the tree. Following a favorable jury ruling, the appeals court affirmed the decision, underscoring the obligation of the utility company to address known risks.

title: Woman conductor dies after being pushed off moving bus in Telangana
description: Gundla Pravalika succumbed to her injuries ten days after she was pushed off a bus. The fatal incident occurred during an argument over bus fare with B Mounika. Following Pravalika's death, police changed the charges against Mounika from attempt to murder to murder. The state government expressed condolences and promised support for Pravalika's family, including a job and insurance.

title: 194 Pennsylvania families eye $1.4bn deal to sell land for data centre
description: In Salem Township, local officials have greenlighted a significant new zoning plan to establish a technology and energy campus. This ambitious $1.4 billion development will span 4,466 acres, affecting 194 families in the area. Alongside the main project, amenities such as a micro-hospital and recreational spaces are promised to enhance community welfare. However, property transfers will require further environmental assessments and reviews before finalization.

title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre: How anti-Indian politics burned GOP in its stronghold
Michigan neighbours get $55,750 for dock built on land they did not own
description: Legal issues arose for Jeremy and Ivanna Leffring when their neighbors placed a 'No Trespassing' sign on what they considered shared property. Following joint construction of a boardwalk and dock, the new property owners contested their agreement. The Michigan Court of Appeals favored the Leffrings, granting them $55,750 for their improvements while asserting that no formal easement could be enforced.

title: 3 Naga militants killed in Manipur factional gunfight
description: Three militants lost their lives in a clash between Zeliangrong groups in Manipur's Noney district. The conflict arose after accusations were made regarding one group's collaboration with security forces. Additionally, there was gunfire directed at passenger vehicles in Ukhrul, though no injuries occurred. The Manipur government has initiated measures to restore peace through the establishment of local peace committees.

description: On October 28, Sajina Begum accidentally drove her SUV into Halevuru kebab centre, injuring three men. The incident occurred when she felt dizzy and mistakenly pressed the accelerator instead of the brakes. Paramesh A filed a complaint after she failed to fulfill her promise to cover repair costs and medical expenses. While Safrulla Abdul Aziz claimed to have already paid approximately Rs 75,000 for the injuries, the matter remains unclear.

title: Texas couple lost home in 2001, took reverse mortgage in 2011; court revives case
description: A Texas appeals court has reopened a lengthy dispute over home ownership in Houston, which has complicated legal issues. The case involves multiple foreclosures, reverse mortgages, and unclear ownership claims spanning twenty-five years. Key questions remain about the validity of a 2011 mortgage after a previous foreclosure occurred in 2001. This ruling requires lower courts to thoroughly examine competing ownership claims before making decisions.

title: How Florida turned toy rabbits into robots to lure pythons & protect Everglades
description: Florida researchers created robotic rabbits to attract invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. These decoys imitate real prey by moving and generating heat, aiding in detection. The project employs remote monitoring to facilitate python removal by the South Florida Water Management District. Traditional methods relied on live rabbits, which posed logistics challenges, making robotic alternatives more practical. Current testing continues with future plans to add scent to enhance effectiveness.

title: 17 years after Michael Jackson's death, daughter Paris seeks $600M for trust
description: In a legal move, Paris Jackson has petitioned the court for a $600 million transfer to the family trust. While the estate has generated significant income since Michael Jackson's passing, his children have yet to see the trust funded. Its executors cite unresolved tax matters as a barrier. Paris believes that as she and her brothers near their thirties, distributions should begin.

title: Amrita Rao says she kept son away from TV and gadgets for first five years
description: Bollywood actor Amrita Rao and RJ Anmol chose to keep their son Veer away from screens during his early years. The couple maintained this screen-free environment by engaging him through conversation and audio stories. They also emphasized shared parenting responsibilities while striving to get family members involved in the decision. Their approach included offering satvik food and avoiding packaged snacks for Veer.

title: Gold, silver lose shine ahead of Dhanteras: Buy now, wait or invest in something else?
description: As Dhanteras nears, Indian consumers are closely monitoring the recent drop in gold and silver prices, scrutinizing how this volatility might influence future values. Financial experts advise buyers to assess their personal needs and investment objectives before making any purchases. With more price changes anticipated in the months ahead, a gradual buying approach is recommended to handle potential risks effectively, ensuring that purchases reflect one's investment philosophy.
